svg.title: The catalog, counted
svg.desc: On the reference build 26A5416b: 31,029 BVG documents decoded, 7,209 symbols generated, 1,615 localized drawings, one square per 50; and every symbol on 9 weights, 3 scales, 4 rendering modes and 12 effects.
svg.text: ultralight, thin, light, regular, medium, semibold, bold, heavy, black
Appear, Disappear, Bounce, Pulse, Breathe, Wiggle, Rotate, Scale,
Draw On/Off, Variable Color, Replace, Magic Replace
ONE SMALL SQUARE = 50 DOCUMENTS, SYMBOLS OR DRAWINGS, THE LAST ONE PARTLY FILLED. REFERENCE BUILD 26A5416b, MACOS 27 BETA 6.
